placeholders.replaced_by: graph ref of the Samtec QTH-060-01-L-D-A (pcb/partition-spec.json b2b.mpn.pwr_b) once its land, derived from the dimensions of the Samtec recommended PCB layout Rev M, is vendored (GR-4 / PCB-PWRA lineage); only the contact numbers of this pin map carry over, then PWR_B and PWR_A are re-routed
placeholders.pending: B2B ref pending: Samtec QTH-060-01-L-D-A land not derived and vendored yet, no graph ref (GR-4 / PCB-PWRA OPEN)
placeholders.pins_source: generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_B/make_spec.py b2b_pin_map() from pcb/generated/b2b-nets.json (sha256 0070cf483d67c0ba2cb0b29629961b04f89c11126aa82bebad9b510c98d44705): every crossing net with its contact count, one GND contact per power net
placeholders.why: The QTH-060-01-L-D-A has no KiCad 10.0.7 footprint and its land is not vendored yet (build/kicad/footprints/ belongs to the GR-4 / PCB-PWRA lineage), so pcb/partition-spec.json b2b has no graph ref. Samtec's RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT FOR QTH-XXX-XX-X-D-XXX (https://suddendocs.samtec.com/prints/qth-xxx-xx-x-d-xxx-footprint.pdf, Rev M, 2024-01-26, FOOTPRINT FOR QTH-060-01-X-D-XXX SHOWN) is readable (HTTP 200, read 2026-11-07; the 403 that GR-3 recorded no longer holds) but carries a Samtec proprietary note, so the PDF is fetch-only and the land must be derived from its dimensions: 0.500 mm contact pitch, banks 20.003 mm apart, ground-plane pads 2 per bank. The placeholder is the official KiCad 10.0.7 Hirose FX8-120P-SV land (2 x 60 contacts, 0.6 mm pitch, no ground-plane pad, courtyard 43.6 x 7.9 against the QTH-060 catalogue outline 40.0 x 7.11, F-226 qth.pdf). It keeps routing, DRC and the pin map checkable as a model, but only its contact numbers carry over: the FX8 contact coordinates, the fan-out, connectors.json positions and the GND-contact return (the QTH carries GND on its ground plane, 25 A per plane, F-226) are placeholder-only. Hirose rates FX8 contacts at 0.4 A (FX8/FX8C Series Catalog p. 3 Rated Current, distributor copy https://media.e-sonic.com/productfiles/mf-HR/HR-FX8120SSV21.pdf, read 2026-11-07), below the 1 A per contact of this pin map (LAB5 4 A on 4 contacts): the placeholder must never be populated, and the fab set stays MODEL_NOT_FOR_FABRICATION until the QTH land replaces it. It is not the part to buy; its socket Connector_Hirose_FX8:Hirose_FX8-120S-SV_2x60_P0.6mm (sha256 82ef2a7f5fbd930b90d97ef39fd59bbc18f8f31c22ec51cee135ad045241a67b) is the PWR-A placeholder mate.
